confidence_notes: Meal, coffee and beer estimates use [August 2026 restaurant medians](https://www.averagecostof.living/in/estonia/tallinn/restaurants/) as a proxy for July. Cocktail and wine estimates are less certain, following [local 2026 ranges](https://eurocityguide.com/estonia/tallinn-nightlife-guide) at roughly 1.8 and 1.25 times the beer price. July accommodation is modeled and seasonally variable.
comparable_city_reasoning: Riga and Vilnius provide a regional basis, adjusted for Tallinn's northern European tourism market and July demand.
